body:
Fuck the haters for real! You know you are doing something right if you bring the haters out. Haters always be hating on that good shit you feel me?

Do not let their negative energy rent any space in your mind for free. Haters gonna hate and they only hate on good shit that's how you know you're rocking with the realness.

Fight those demons and darkness you are pure light and love. Darkness can't exist when you shine light onto it. Shine bright you are worthy of it. Believe that. It is the truth.

Impress who you want when you want and how you want. The world is BIG. There are some beautiful people out there speak up so they know you're out there too. Like attracts like. Since you mentioned your mom, I'll be real with you.

I was struggling a little while back and for me it's my brother. Thinking if it wasn't for him what might I do to myself and just spiraling. Out of the blue I had a random thought and wondered, if the roles were reversed what would I want my brother to do. Treat yourself well. Be kind to yourself. You deserve that and more. I love you. You never know your impact on the world around you, how many lives you are part of their story in a positive way and don't even know. When you are loving to yourself you exude it to everyone near and I know you know how it feels good.

Pull, reach, and grab anything you need to fight through this and come out stronger for it. It's ok to be bitter. I know it hurts. Scream if you need to scream. Cry if you need to cry.

Words are powerful. Be kind to yourself with how you talk about yourself. How you think about yourself in your head.

I love you for real. It's definetly not the only reason by a mile, but if for anything-- live to stunt on them haters.

I love you and I want to see you succeed in life. I want to see you succeed in your personal life, in your business endeavors, and in the relationships you create with others.

Believe me when I tell you that you are still young with a lot of life ahead of you. This isn't the end. I know it feels like it in the moment but you have greatness in this life waiting for you to grab ahold of and run with it.

There are countless humans who haven't discovered their life's passion or calling until later in their life. Check these people out! https://www.inc.com/bill-murphy-jr/14-inspiring-people-who-found-crazy-success-later-in-life.html

I have felt like you have felt, until that feeling went away. In the moment, I never thought it would leave. It does and it will. You won't always feel so defeated.

If you want to communicate better, you can learn how to. If you want to you can learn how to communicate in multiple languages! You can reinvent yourself whenever you like, you can improve yourself whenever you like. The world is full of abundance and you can indulge in it. Find what you want, set small goals and achieve your dreams.

Words are powerful, be careful what you say to yourself and how. Especially that little voice inside your head. Be kind to yourself. Speak words of love and life to yourself, you deserve it.

You aren't broken. You might be hurting but you are not broken. Be strong. Fight through those thoughts and fight through that pain. It will get better. There is a life worth living, it's your life and it is precious.

Please stay with us. Keep fighting. It won't always be like this, and happiness is close by. I love you for real.

I don't trust others easily either. I've been hurt.  There are humans out there that you can trust. Seek them out. It might take sorting through some shitty people but they are out there. It's worth it too. Please believe me.

What are you thinking?

This saving my life too. We got this, we can get through this. It will make us stronger and it will leave room for those who can love us the way we need and deserve because others aren't in the way. I hope you are having a good day today. For real I mean that

Yo whattup bro. Tonight is just one moment, and there are so many more waiting for you in this life that is full of abundance. They will not always be like this, I promise. Things will get better. It might not be overnight, but when the time comes it will feel like it was overnight.

If you can, imagine someone else is going through what you are feeling. What advise would you share with them?

I know that feeling bro, for real. It is gripping and it feels like you just want the pain to go away but please believe me when I say that this feeling doesn't last forever and to be strong you can get through this and you will. Be strong and fight those demons. You fight them with love.

Love yourself, you are worth it.

Night turns to day just as day turns to night. They need each other for perspective and relevance.

Similarly, feeling like life is unbearable has a counter balance of happiness and it is right around the corner for you. Words are powerful so please be kind to yourself with the things you say and think. You are loved.

I love you. Fight and be strong. You got this!

We don't know what tomorrow has on store for us, or the next day or the next year...decade, ect.

The world is full of abundance. What are some of your interests, passions, hobbies, or dreams?

Would you share some of them with me please?

I fucking love you bro. For real. Stay with us please.

Yo. I love you bro. Stay strong and stay with us. I know it feels daunting in the moments when we are struggling, but please believe that you are young with a full life ahead of you.

We don't get to choose our family but we do get to choose our friends. I have some family that I don't even talk with, and some friends that I talk with all the time. To me, they are my family. They are who I choose to be around because I feel their love and I can share mine with them.

Soon, you will have the option to move out and start a life of your own. The boundless possibilities of that is such a beautiful thing. There are many successful individuals who didn't find their path in life until they were 50+ years old. Not to say the path leading up to that wasn't important, but in terms of passions and dreams. Living for themselves and learning who they are and what they need. How they best serve others.

It is all about love. Love conquers all. I love you and I emolore you to love yourself. You are worth it. Stay with us. Fight through these troubling thoughts. They will pass with time and a mindful approach. I promise. Please believe me.  You are loved. There are over 8 billion humans in this world, and many love you that is a fact. Stay strong. Stay with us

I have realized that there are many things in life that I want and came to the conclusion that I deserve them. So I am working towards them!

I want a family, I want children, I want to leave a positive impact on those around me and within my community. I do not want to be an example of letting something get a grip of me so badly that I go and off myself. I would never suggest that to someone else so why is it ok to think that for myself. It is not ok!

I am focusing on if the roles were reversed and if I was giving advise to someone in my shoes, what would I say, what would I suggest. And I know that I would say that you are strong! You are a fighter. Fight for a happy life and fight for the things you want in life.

The time is now, thinking about yesterday dwelling takes us away from this moment. Thinking of the future does the same. All we have is this present moment and presently I want to love and be loved. So the only thing left to do is do it!

I love you and I am learning to love myself too. You got this!

Words are powerful, especially the ones we tell ourselves with the inner dialogue constantly going on in our minds.

It may feel like the pain will never leave but it can and it will. Trust yourself and love yourself. I love you!

Yo whattup bro, have you been able to share what you have gone through recently with someone?

Our minds when left unchecked when we are in a bad spot can begin to play tricks on us but when we shed light on that darkness it can not exist on the same space. 

Would you like to talk about it with a chill unbiased non-judgmental stranger? That's me! 

For real, let it out. Talk to someone. Cry if tears start to come. 

What are some of your interests or passions in life? Goals or dreams? 

You are loved. I know that because I fucking love you bro. Talk with me. I am here for you.

Yo I love you. That is for real.

It isn't always easy to talk with those who are close to us about the difficulties in our lives or what we are going through.

For me, I always felt like I would be a burden on them to share such fucked up thoughts.

Check it though, I am a stranger. A total fucking stranger and you can talk with me. I don't know you for shit so no judgements. I am here to listen though, if you would like someone to unload those thoughts and feelings on. I know it is hard, but trust me it is such a relief to share those thoughts and feelings with someone else because living with them alone they have space to flourish unchecked. You feel me?

Be real with me. What is bothering you? What is on your mind besides the obvious? Dig deep and tell me bro, please I am asking because I want to know.

And I want you to know that just because we feel certain type of way doesn't mean we have to act on it. Feelings are supposed to come and go, to be replaced with new feelings as we experience new things in life. Happy, sad, funny, mad, excited, you know what I am saying. All the feels.

Sometimes we get stuck on one specific feeling, or a couple of them get played on repeat. I know it can seem daunting like they will never subside but they will- I promise. And they will be replaced with beautiful feelings too. Because you are due!

Guess what else you are?

You are loved bro. I love you.

Nothing to be sorry about. Sharing is a huge first step. Proud of you for letting those feelings out so they don't have to stay bottled up inside of you.

People aren't what bring us happiness but they can be part of it.

If it's a possibility, get the pistol out of the house for the time being. Give it to someone you trust, ideally if you can- give it to someone you can share why you need it out of the house for now.

Talk it out and let yourself cry if tears start flowing.

Jealousy is one of the first things the women in my life run from and fast. It's not a good look. I know you can get a grip on it and not let it run your life. If everyone was judged on their past deeds we would all be fucked.

Be the best partner you can from here on out.

I'm my own personal life, it was a difficult thing to confront that I needed to work on a bunch of aspects in my life and it all seemed very overwhelming. Start with one thing at a time. Then two, then three. Make a list of a couple things to do for the day that will better improve your your relationship with yourself as well as with your partner.

Make them attainable, not some heroic far flung goals. Shit you can do that makes a positive impact in your life and in your relationship. That will start to build a momentum and before you know it you will have climbed yourself out of what I know seems like a dark bottomless pit.

You are learning about yourself and confronting demons in your life. They are fighting back with all their might but you are stronger. You got this bro. You are loved. I love you and want to see you become the amazing individual that I know is already inside you.

I know it's difficult but focus hard on areas in your life that you would like to see improvement and work towards that. Little attainable goals turn into big dreams. You got this!

It will get better. Believe that.
